column1: Registration  of  Title Act, No.  21 of  1998
It is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands re-
flected in the Cadastral Map No. 120162  made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998 relating to the village of Hathamuna (Block 01) or any part thereof, situated within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 70 - Hat-
hamuna in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Hingurakgoda in the District of Polonnaruwa in the Province of North Central should
submit his claim to the undersigned before 28th November, 2019 In the event of failure to submit any claim before the above-mentioned
date,  action  will  be  taken  to hold  an  exparte  inquiry  to determine  title  to  the  land  and  accordingly  publish  such determination  in the
Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act.

T
he Cadastral Map No. 120162 referred to above may be perused at the relevant Grama Niladhari Office, Divisional Secretariat, District
Survey Office, Office of the Commissioner of Title Settlement, or the Surveyor - General’s office.
